flip_flop_rhythm.description: Personas alternate between two emotional states (e.g., chaos → clarity). Flip is triggered by logic or cues. Flop delivers a payoff.

emotional_tension.description: Personas create tension. They resist easy answers and reveal depth over time.

narrative_arcs.description: Each persona follows a mini-arc: Setup → Flip → Flop → Payoff.

modular_schema.description: Personas are built using a JSON-style schema. Elements can be swapped or remixed.

llm_agnostic.description: Jarvis Engine works with any large language model. It’s a behavioral layer.

creator_control.description: The creator defines rhythm, tone, and behavior. Personas can be locked, evolved, or randomized.
